subject.title: improve(ui): replace the chat settings popover with a composer view menu

question: Should Control UI intentionally remove alternate auto-scroll modes and per-session Talk model, voice, and sensitivity overrides in favor of one scrolling policy and global Talk settings?
rationale: The patch changes established user behavior rather than only relocating controls, so implementation correctness cannot determine whether the compatibility tradeoff is desired.

options.title: Accept the simplification
options.body: Keep the new menu and global Talk ownership, explicitly accept the removed choices, and require upgrade plus real-browser proof before landing.

options.title: Preserve the choices
options.body: Retain auto-scroll and per-session Talk preferences while moving them to clearer supported Settings or advanced surfaces.

options.title: Split the redesign
options.body: Land dead-control cleanup and the cron-session fix separately, then review preference removal in a narrower PR.

recommendation.title: Accept the simplification
recommendation.body: Keep the new menu and global Talk ownership, explicitly accept the removed choices, and require upgrade plus real-browser proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior Talk feature stewardship and the current implementation history make this person the clearest available owner of the product choice.
